HEARING OF ANTRINA LAVONNE CRAWFORD'S PETITION FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-01-2026 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: The matter came on for Change of name and gender of Petitioner ANTRINA LAVONNE CRAWFORD.

Dept.505; Judge: Michelle Tong; Clerk: N. Webb; Proceedings not reported.

Petitioner: ANTRINA LAVONNE CRAWFORD appeared in pro per, was placed under oath and testified.
Respondent: NAKILAH CROWFORD is present in pro per via zoom video conference, is placed under oath and testifies.

Petition for change of name filed March 9, 2026.

Order to show cause filed March 9, 2026.

Notice of hearing filed April 23, 2026.

The Court addresses the petitioner.

The Petitioner provides testimony.

The Court addresses the Respondent.

The Respondent provides testimony.

After reviewing the petition, hearing the testimony and the objections filed, The Court grants Petitioner's request for change of name.

Order for name change signed and filed this day. (NW/D505)
